list.name: list_todos
list.description: Read the user's own commitments. 'owe' means the user owes someone; 'waiting' means someone else owes the user. Returns id, text, person, direction, due_date, status, overdue, source_meeting_title, source, source_agent, and mention_count, ordered like Todos (overdue, dated, no date, then waiting). Filters by status, direction, person, and local due date. Archived rows require include_archived. Returns at most 50 rows within an 8 KB payload, truncating large output. Read only; cannot create, edit, complete, or reject todos.

status.description: Todo status; default open. 'all' includes every status.

direction.description: 'owe' is what the user owes; 'waiting' is what someone else owes the user; default both.

person.description: Case-insensitive person name or email match; optional.

due.description: Local calendar date: overdue is an open, owed todo before today; today is today's date; week is today through six days ahead; none has no due date; default all.

limit.description: Maximum rows, default 20; values above 50 are clamped to 50.

include_archived.description: Include archived todos as well as active todos; default false.

get.name: get_todo
get.description: Read the full stored row of one of the user's own commitments by ID, including source, source_agent, quote, quote_segment_index, source_note_id, source_note_title, speaker_confidence, rejected_reason, and the last 10 mentions. 'waiting' means someone else owes the user. Archived todos return not found. Returns only stored todo fields and quotes, never note content; large fields may be truncated to keep the payload within 8 KB. Read only; cannot create, edit, complete, or reject todos.

create.name: create_todo
create.description: Create one todo explicitly requested by the user. The row is attributed to this agent.

text.description: Todo text; whitespace and newlines are normalized.

due_date.description: Real calendar date in yyyy-mm-dd format, without a time.

quote.description: The sentence the agent is acting on.

update.name: update_todo
update.description: Change one todo's status, due date, or person. User-pinned fields stay unchanged.

anyOf.description: Real calendar date in yyyy-mm-dd format, without a time.
